answer: What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Each submission hangs on the basalt of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
